text_block_list.text:
Taking 1st place in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe,
claiming the long-awaited dream everyone had longed for—
After returning to the country, daily life changed completely.

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
And now, please welcome our special guests!
<chrname> and the one who guided her,
Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: TV Celebrity
text_block_list.text: Waaah, it's the real deal~!

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text: <chrname> merchandise is now on sale~

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Crap, gotta buy it fast!
All the stores in my neighborhood were wiped out too~.

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, <chrname> is so cool~♪
Seriously love it, super love it, adore it~!

Day after day, requests for interviews and appearances poured in.
The schedule was completely filled with media commitments.

However, that is something
<chrname> has already accounted for.
Telling myself that it was all to pave the way for next year's activities.

"...The reason <chrname>
was able to lead the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe
was thanks to the baton passed by everyone."
The turf experience gained from the 'Representative Exchange Race,' the training facilities upon arriving on-site, and more than enough sparring partners ready to go.
That was made possible because "Project L'Arc" managed to endure. And supporting it is—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I don't just want people all over Japan to dream;
I want them to be among those who help make it happen.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: The amount one person can save or a single organization can cover is negligible. But if all of Japan were to support it...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...It should give a push to the backs of all Umamusume who ever dreamed of being number one in the world.

“—Next year, I'm sure even more Umamusume
will want to join Project L'Arc.”

Without a generous budget, the amount we can allocate
to each person will decrease. That would be a problem.

Because <chrname> still has every intention
of winning the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
choice_data_list: If you win next year, that'll be back-to-back victories.
If you win next year, that'll be back-to-back victories.

text_block_list.text:
"As someone who has become a bona fide 'star,'
I must do whatever I can."

It felt as though the expression on <chrname>'s face
had matured compared to last year.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yo, champ!
Let me learn a thing or two from ya!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Senpai, that's so shameless of you.
Trainer <username>, we're looking forward to today's mock race."
choice_data_list: Likewise, I look forward to working with you

text_block_list.text:
Our schedules finally lined up today,
and we took part in a mock race against the senior Trainers' Umamusume.
And the gates opened—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
*pant*..., *pant*...!
Trainer <username>...!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: <chrname> is...!
choice_data_list: ...? We're in the middle of a mock race, you know?

text_block_list.text:
"To show Mei Satake, I point toward <chrname> running on the track.
That running style—"

...It was far from her usual self,
a run that was noticeably lackluster.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me,
Trainer <username>."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Could you stop her? Right this second.

I quickly halted the mock race
and took <chrname> to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
From a brief examination, it doesn't look like an injury,
but just in case, I will write a referral to the university hospital
so please get a detailed checkup.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe, and Satono Diamond too, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Former Academy Chairwoman
text_block_list.text:
"...Are her legs all right!?
It looked like in the second half of the race—"

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I won't let that girl race for a while.
Rest will be our top priority.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"We completely overlooked it.
The risks of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Her damage is severe.
It's most likely caused by
running in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
European racecourses are completely different from Japan's.
When the environment changes, it's only natural
for fatigue and stress to build up.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"...However, excessive excitement paralyzes the brain.
It fools you into thinking it's okay for everything to end here."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Your awareness of the pain fades away.
To the point where you can easily ignore your own limits.

text_block_list.name: Former Academy Chairwoman
text_block_list.text: "...I wonder if she would've avoided that injury and slump if she'd never shared this dream with us."

text_block_list.name: Former Academy Chairwoman
text_block_list.text:
Mei. What we're lacking
is always experience.

text_block_list.name: Former Academy Chairwoman
text_block_list.text: Make sure... you don't make a mistake.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...Who was it that drove them to this?
Who was it that failed to stop them?"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Even though I knew the right support from those around her could change that girl's life...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Who blinded their eyes with dreams?!
Who crushed them beneath expectations?!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
What was I doing...!
I'm supposed to be the one in charge...!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
You don't have the slightest right
to rob them of their potential...!!
